en: There are so many places I couldn't nap!
I'm gonna help! Then: I'm gonna sleep. Then I'll help some more! Maybe. Unless I wanna sleep again...
I summon Patron, then I go home.
No patrons needed. I'll find my way.
My bed is cozy and the outside is mean.
(Alt: My bed is cozy and the outside is mean!)
Let's see if we can get you home.
Oh, that's stupid. Have better dreams.
Why are you carrying a pillow?
This is no place for a child.
Probably not. That's why Imma follow you!
You can be my big brother that stabs people!
How can I get a jacket like yours?
Are you the best at anything?
You're not getting a jacket like this. Sorry.
Uhh, you mean like... have aspirations, or see things when they sleep?
Oh, when you sleep, silly! No one cares about your "aspirations".
Sorry mate. Is what it is.
I hope to meet her one day.
Well, if all goes well, you'll get the chance.
Mr. Bebop, I have a question.
I heard that you fight in the Bear Pit. But when I went, there were no bears. It wasn't even a pit! It was a circle with two people punchin' each other!
How could I have fun when there were no bears?! They should call it the Human Circle.
Um... he- Uh... can I please eat your cat?
I don't care. Touch my cat, and she'll be eating you.
After the ritual, you will tell me everything.
So Calico, what do you do for a job? Are you fireman? Or a school teacher? Or cat groooomer?
Oh, I don't think I should talk to you...
Hey little guy, what's your name?
Are you really a unicorn? Cause you look like a unicorn.
I dunno. No one's told me a secret.
Well, I don't know I can tell ya then.
If you can't find your way home, you can stay with me for a while.
Yeah! Folks like us need to stick together.
I bet your dreams are scary.
Not particularly. I sleep like a baby.
That's cause I murdered someone before I showed up for the ritual.
A musician's gotta warm up before they perform.
You're not gonna whine about morality, are ya?
Hehehe, stick with me, kid! I teach you all sorts of things.
Why, hello there! I'm Professor Dynamo.
I have so many questions for you, Rem.
There's no such thing as stupid questions.
I don't know, I bet that I could come with a couple, like... is the sky made of peanut butter? Can you make a desk out of pillows? How do you find the area of a triangle?
The sky is not made of peanut butter, while technically possible a desk made solely out of pillows would not be structurally sound, and one-half the base times the height.
Can I be your class pet?
In college, we don't have class pets.
Professor Dynamo, you seem pretty smart. Is it true that adults don't take naps?
I imagine everyone would be less cranky if they did, Rem.
Well, stick with me, I'll take care of you.
Why can't I talk to them?
But, if I'm listening, I can't ask them questions like: what's your favorite color, and why does bread taste good, and do you think cats would smoke if they had thumbs?
You look like someone who likes bowling.
Whose dream did you come from?
I don't think I'm supposed to tell you.
I like naps. Do you like naps?
I'm going to get you home.
I trust you. You're my mom!
You're fine, Rem. It's… it was nice to see you.
I'm sorry, I don't know the area. Have you talked to the police?
Have you talked to the police that live here?
Why would I do that when I'm talking to you?
Cause they–... Just stay close to me, we'll talk after the Ritual.
I don't know if I could pull that off, little man.
You have a hat, and I have a hat!
Stay inside my dome, little one. It will protect you.
It's a result of becoming a revenant.
It's not a "why" so much as a "how".
Kelvin: You're one of those adults that makes no sense but uses big words to make it sound they do.
And you thought this ritual was your ticket home?
Well, I want my kinda-mom to help me, but her kinda-dad is gonna get mad about it.
Family can be complicated... I'm sorry.
Me too. Oh well, let's go fight now!
Why do you have a lady trapped in a bottle?
Is that a grown-up word for criminal?
Oh, goodness... no, Djinn are special people that sleep in bottles, like you sleep in beds.
I get it. If I could sleep in a bottle, I would too!
That's because I don't know where I am.
Ah. Another victim of American divorce.
Does the bottle lady have name?
Oh, she's not my pet. Actually, if she were out of her vessel, she would probably say I'm her property.
No... well, yes, it- it is, but, uh... that's not what she would mean if she said I was her property, her... hers is a dry wit!.. Okay, what- what is the point, you don't care.
Ah, you don't need to worry about Maurice, he's a teddy bear. Well, mole. Teddy mole. No, that... that doesn't work either. I'm just going to assume you can understand nuance?
Oh! No need to get sassy, my friend!
I wanna play with Rabies Ronnie!
I wanna play with Rabies Ronnie!
I don't think I like you.
I see the Patron looks to test my patience today.
Fine. Rem. Listen to me. If the ritual fails and you are on your own, stay away from anyone who mentions the OSIC!
They will not help you get home. Trust me.
Can I use your jacket as a blanket?!
I mean, in general, sure, but not now.
I don't know. Can you pay me?
Don't worry. I'll shepherd you home.
I thought priests were supposed to be nice.
I'm pretty sure you're about to kill people.
Are you sure you're a priest?
I don't expect you to understand the nuance of my world.
Nuance sounds like a big word.
Don't worry about it. Just know I'll protect you.
You say that now, but you'll like me.
Hey kid, you ready to be an accessory?
I mean- Look, I'm not gonna lie to you kid, we're not exactly great, but we are a lotta fun!
Well, I like fun! So, I guess I like criminals!
If I get rid of my pillow, I can't take a nap.
You're in New York, baby! Who needs sleep?
One... two... three... you have four arms!
Why do you need extra hands?
Tell ya what: You keep me from dying, I'll give you the hat.
Do you always carry cards with you?
Why do you carry your pillow everywhere?
Because you never know when you're going to find the time to take a na- Oh! Now I get it!
This pillow makes me feel safe.
Wanna see how far I can throw this?
It's soft for me, but it's not soft for them!
Ima hit em with a pillow!
Ima throw my pillow at 'em cause I'm carryin' a pillow and that's really all I can throw!
Well, I'm not gonna throw my candle at 'em, that would be crazy!
I'm not throwing my pillow, I'm using my pillow...
It's soft for me, but it's not soft for them!
I'm going to go sleep now...
I wanna hang out with my new friends.
I think I might need a nap.
I'll feel better after a nap.
I'm just gonna close my eyes for a second.
The best part of being asleep, is being asleep.
Viscous likes cubes. I like pillows...
They're good at doing things I'm too lazy to do, heh.
It's not safe to travel alone.
I don't know, you guys do it.
Ready to put them to sleep.
I can put them to sleep now.
Let me know when you want them to go to bed.
People are grumpy when they're tired.
People can't be mean when they're asleep.
I'm not ready to sleep, I'm awake.
Can't be mad when you're asleep.
It's okay, Mr. Washington, you can be president.
You should be nicer to me!
I just wanted to take a nap!
I guess havin' a lot of souls doesn't solve all your problems.
You weren't nice to me earlier.
I don't know what's happening, but it's a lot.
What do you mean I can't eat ice cream on a roller coaster?..
I got a good feeling 'bout this!
I'm glad I'm awake to see this!
Of course they can't stop me, I've brought my lucky pillow!
No one stops me from goin' home!
They should be nicer to me...
I can keep doin' this, sure!..
Sorry, I keep breaking his things...
I dunno why they keep fighting, they're dumb.
I guess I keep winning then!..
So this is what it's like to be tall!
I'm ready to do it again!
I might want to train a power.
I want candy. Or a gun. Probably candy, but maybe a gun, I dunno!
I wonder what I can buy now!
I need to see what they have at the Store.
I should go by the Curiosity Shoppy.
I can get somethin' really cool now!
I might wanna buy something new.
I'mma buy the bestest thing ever!
Time to break open the piggy bank and buy somethin'.
Ooh, I should get those souls!
Who left those souls lyin' around?
So they've got some souls, big deal!
We need to keep this up.
Oh, I love hide and seek!
Come out and play with me!
I don't think they're too friendly.
They aren't very nice, are they?
I don't know guys, you really shouldn't give me responsibilities.
I don't like being the last one alive.
Oh boy, this is not good...
I don't think this a good fight.
I don't wanna pick that fight.
What do we wanna do? What do we wanna do?
Uhhh, guys, they have the Rejuvenator!
We need to regroup and have a plan.
I don't wanna miss the end!
Wait guys--don't summon the patron without me!
I'mma summon a god, I'mma get home, then I'mma take a nap.
I'll see ya later! Bye, don't die!
Uuugh, I'm not feelin' so good...
They say if you snooze, you lose, but that's not true cause I snooze all the time and look at me now!
Why yes, Mr. Darcy, I will marry you...
An interesting theory, Mr. Poirot, but I know who really killed Jay Gatsby...
I think I'm gonna stick with you guys.
Anyone else wanna take a nap?
Hope you guys are ready cause I'm really tired.
Part of me hopes that after today, we'll be friends for life, but if everything goes well, Ima go home and never see you guys again. So we can be friends and never talk to each other!
They say if you snooze, you lose, but that's not true cause I snooze all the time and look at me now!
Three of me could wear his coat.
I don't want him to read from that book again.
He had glasses, but he wasn’t nice!
He thought he was better than me.
I don't know if he's mean, but he's definitely not nice.
I liked playing with the golem.
I bet Billy could teach me all kinds of fun words.
I probably shouldn't hang out with Billy 'til I'm older.
I can't tell if Billy is a fun big kid, or a mean big kid.
I think her cat hissed at me.
You kill people for money. That's mean!
I don’t want to be eaten by her cat...
I wonder if I can eat the cat?
I don't wanna play with Drifter.
He didn't have a happy smile.
I don't want to be hat brothers with him...
I want to be his friend but he's dead.
I don't know why she's playing with a dead hand, that's weird.
I'm worried about his blood pressure.
I see her when I sleep.
Oh, I hope she's not mad...
He's so cool, and dead, but still cool.
He works at a fancy place that I'm not supposed to be allowed in.
I want you to be my friend.
One day I'll ride on your back, and it will be awesome!
Can I be an Arroyo too?
Flying through the air looks fun.
I heard Lash fights bears, which makes me tougher than a bear!
I think she snuggles with metal.
I like toys. She likes toys. We could be friends.
I don't think I like people with pointy teeth.
You should design pajamas. Those are cooler than dresses.
Thanks for dying and not drinking my blood!
Can I go bowling with you later?
She needs to read me a bedtime story.
I want her to read me every day, but not today.
(Alt: I want her to read to me every day, but not today!)
I like you, Paige. Sorry you're dead.
I wish I had a sister as cool as her.
She has an hourglass where her face is!
Can I hide in your briefcase?
Your coat smells like the sewer.
If your mom isn't nice, you can hang out with my mom.
I think Pocket needs a hug!
I bet he's secretly really nice when he is not trying to kill people.
I feel bad for his subjects.
Yeah, I'm scared of humans sometimes too.
He's spooky, but fun spooky, 'til he kills people, then he's scary spooky.
I bet he has lots of secrets...
I love naps as much as he loves knives!
I think she wanted to eat me.
I never met someone whose hair smelled like Bourbon.
She'll be nicer when she sleeps it off.
I bet her fur feels nice...
I don't like card tricks, they all end the same!
My friend once told me, magicians are jerks because they lie for money.
Looks like I made you disappear!
Do the trick where you die again!
Oh, I don't know if those two are gonna make it.
I don't know much about priests, but I don't think they're supposed to shoot people.
He was like a big leprechaun with a gun.
He looks scary, but cool scary, not monster scary.
He has a name I can't pronounce.
He smells like gunpowder and incense.
He's probably okay with being dead.
He's like a stuffy. Only, instead of fluff, he's filled with dead things.
I wonder if his different parts have different dreams...
I agree, Vindicta. Shoes are stupid.
I wish I could fly like her.
Goo is fun to play with.
Goo guy seemed fun. Now he seems dead.
You can be my cool aunt.
I don't know why people hate her.
Don't worry, Vyper. One day I'll have money, and then you can mug me!
I hope I get to hang out with her before she gets arrested again!
I bet he's mad all the time!
I don't know what this guy's deal is.
I bet he'd be happier after a nap.
She had four arms, that's weird.
Maybe she'd fight better if her hands weren't in her pockets.
I don't know what "degenerate gambler" means, but it sounds fun!
I didn't like your card trick!
She's like a magician that shoots people instead of doing magic tricks.
I think people would like her more if she stopped trying to stab everybody.
She doesn’t look like a Yamato...
Ugh, go back to the petting zoo! Or wherever you crawled out of...
I don't know what that thing was, but it's dead.
I know better than to be deceived by appearances.
It doesn't matter how cute it looked, it was a threat.
I feel pretty bad about that…
They looked so cute with their little hat and pillow too…
I wish I could make him a pet.
I'm gonna feel bad about that for a while...
I'm sorry I couldn't protect you.
We don't have those back in Macomb.
Wish I could give that thing a hug.
Yeah... I'ma feel pretty bad about that.
Look... I get it. I wanna have a nap too!
I dunno what the hell that was, but it's dead.
He was a cute little guy.
I hope he finds a way home.
A shame he couldn't pick better friends.
If only we got to him sooner. We could've helped him.
I almost feel a twinge of guilt... Fascinating...
Better to die at my hands than end up with the OSIC!
I'm gon' feel guilty about that later.
Stay out of my way, Rem.
Go back to whatever hole you've crawled out of.
I'm not fallin' for the cute façade.
Furry bastard got what he deserved.

I'm right here! I'm right here!

I wanna be in the Baxter Society too...

I'm gonna be a teacher's assistant when I grow up...

This'll make you feel better, grandpa.
Sorry for lighting you on fire, your honor...
This is the craziest quinceañera I've ever been to...
I don't know, Geist. Oathkeeper's kinda fun...
I wanna play with the umbrella...

Silver and I are on the case...
I wanna play with the rabbit.
I pulled the pin, now what do I do?
When is it my turn to hold the lightning rod?
Sorry Viscous, I dropped a goo...
I'm puttin' a mortgage on black...
I like your brother too, Kaori...
